period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2024-03-31. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. The comparative prior-year-end Total Assets column in this filing cross-validates exactly (to the taka, after rounding) against this dataset's already-stored 659,114.06mn (2023_Q4.json) total_assets figure, confirming Solo basis continuity and no restatement between the audited annual figure and this interim filing's own comparative column. Net Profit After Tax for Jan-Mar 2024 was BDT +361.03mn, down only slightly from the BDT +376.44mn reported for Jan-Mar 2023 in this same filing's comparative column -- business essentially as usual, no visible sign yet of the collapse that would appear in the FY2024 audited results. However, cumulative Specific Provision for Classified Investment (Note 15(a)) was already BDT +144.53mn, roughly 3.2x the BDT +45.01mn charged in Q1 2023 -- the first quantitative hint of rising credit-quality pressure, though not yet visible in the bottom line.

line_items.metric_note: Cumulative charge (or, if negative, net reversal) for specific provision against classified investments since 1 January. This is the only asset-quality-adjacent figure disclosed in this un-audited interim filing -- the bank's Classified Investment amount/percentage and CRAR are NOT disclosed at interim (Q1/H1/Q3) frequency, only in the annual audited financial statements.

line_items.original_metric_name: Investment / Deposit (calculated: Total Investment / Deposits and Other Accounts)
line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
